purpose: test independent cross-system transport of the Bio Chi scalar/modal construction in the publication-selected deterministic Blum 2019 B3 ERK model without forcing a scalar or interpreting conservation-law zero modes as dynamics

stoichiometric_structure.dynamic_subspace: orthonormal Q spanning col(S), S is the exact 15x16 source reaction stoichiometric matrix
stoichiometric_structure.basis_invariance_control: compare SVD-based Q against an orthonormal QR basis constructed from a fixed independent source-stoichiometry column set; matched reduced eigenvalues must agree within relative complex tolerance 1e-8

primary.role: publication Figure 7 / HSPG model-selection B3 vector

equilibrium_gate.initial_state: source-native initial state with lane-specific fgfr_init_mean, nfb_init, h_init_mean
equilibrium_gate.selection_rule: use the earliest frozen horizon whose terminal ||f(x)||_inf <= 1e-9 and conserved-pool drift <= 1e-8

jacobian_gate.method: analytic reaction-network Jacobian J = S * d(v)/d(x), obtained by exact differentiation of the 16 frozen B3 reaction propensities
jacobian_gate.source_native_rhs_anchor: at every accepted equilibrium, the real-valued complex-safe RHS implementation must match the already source-qualified reproduce_blum_b3_native_v02.py RHS to max absolute difference <= 1e-12

independent_derivative_check.method: complex-step differentiation of a complex-safe implementation of the same source-native B3 ODE

scalar_gate.eligible_objects: all nonreal conjugate pairs of J_r, with no post-result pair selection

cross_lane_transport_logic.modal_transport: report primary and sensitivity complete reduced eigensystems separately; disagreement is representation/parameter sensitivity, not grounds to choose the favorable lane
cross_lane_transport_logic.scalar_transport: broad pair-family transport requires at least one licensed FRET-visible complex pair in both source-defined parameter lanes under at least one common frozen input context; otherwise report the narrower/refused result

next_if_evaluable: freeze and execute B3 local nonlinear round-trip and realized-response joint test only after the v0.2 analytic-Jacobian modal/scalar result is pinned

repair_basis.observed_failure: v0.1 complex modes exceeded the frozen finite-difference step-spread ceiling while basis invariance, eigensystem separation, eigenvector conditioning, and FRET observability remained numerically acceptable
repair_basis.allowed_P0Q_response: replace the failed derivative estimator with an independently qualified analytic derivative; do not loosen or reinterpret the v0.1 pass threshold
